crop.notes: 'CHICAGO NOTES' headline, deck and the Allen paragraph are all captured; the following 'Receipts of Grain' item is cut, which is fine.

ocr.notes: Matches the image; dateline 'CHICAGO, December 13.' omitted and 'Pugilist Tom Allen' rendered 'Tom Allen, the pugilist'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported from Chicago that Tom Allen had arrived there after stopping at Pittsburgh for a jolly time, and that his match with Jim Elliott would be arranged on Friday.

metadata.notes: No page image, so the masthead cannot be checked; dateline 'December 13' agrees with the 1882-12-13 date. Current summary wrongly says December 1871 and brings in McCoole and Mace, who are not in the item. article.json has no focus field.

facts.fact: Allen arrived in Chicago, having stopped at Pittsburgh on the way
A match between Allen and Jim Elliott was to be arranged in Chicago that Friday

notes: Article 102 (1882-12-30) says Allen refused a proposed hippodrome with Elliott in Chicago, so the match apparently did not come off.
